name: Plasma Blitz
effect: Fist Based. Kicking. Lowers the User's Defense and Special Defense by 1 after use. If performed under Electric Terrain, this move gains additional power equal to the difference between the user's Dexterity and the Foe's. A maximum of 3 power can be gained this way.
description: A blitz of electric strikes so fast, they strikes become plasma!
